description: Source code for firmware utility functions including endian reversal, CRC calculations, header construction, and header dumping for firmware images.

methods.name: reverse_endian32
methods.description: Reverses the byte order of a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: reverse_endian16
methods.description: Reverses the byte order of a 16-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: get_buffer_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for a buffer.

methods.name: get_file_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for a file.

methods.name: get_hcs
methods.description: Calculates HCS (Header Checksum) for a header.

methods.name: construct_header
methods.description: Constructs a firmware header with specified parameters.

methods.name: get_control_info
methods.description: Returns string description of control code.

methods.name: dump_header
methods.description: Prints detailed information about a firmware header.

methods.name: print_copyright
methods.description: Prints package version and copyright information.
